title: wait inside if branch inside procedure body — Phase 3 + Phase 2 composition fence
sourceUrl: internal: STATUS.md §1 — waits inside procedure bodies (Phase 3)
problemDescription: Exercises the composition of Phase 2 (waits inside if branches — F-G-13d) and Phase 3 (waits inside procedure bodies). Procedure `branch_wait` contains an if-else whose branches each carry a `wait for` before toggling a caller-side signal formal. Pre-Phase-3, the whole procedure body was dropped textually — the process ran zero-time through six calls and q slammed. Post-fix: ProcedureFrame runs the bound body, dispatches the IfStructure via RunTopIfFromEntryAsync, the BranchFrame yields on the wait, the frame-drain resumes both frames in order. Q alternates '0101'/'1010' with 20/10 ns dwells matching state's oscillation.
